- Normalize $z$: $len = 1 / \sqrt{z_0^2 + z_1^2 + z_2^2}$, then $z_i = z_i \times len$ [S1, unofficial].

The claim describes normalizing a vector z by calculating the length as 1 divided by the square root of the sum of squares of its components, and then multiplying each component by this length. The evidence in Source [S1] explicitly shows the code: `let len = 1 / Math.hypot(z0, z1, z2);` followed by `z0 *= len; z1 *= len; z2 *= len;`. Since `Math.hypot(z0, z1, z2)` computes the square root of the sum of the squares ($z_0^2 + z_1^2 + z_2^2$), the code implements the exact logic described in the claim.
